resolution.question: The Marlin Bay harbor advisory committee needs five of its nine members present to act. Will it reach quorum at its rescheduled Tuesday evening meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if at least five members are present at the meeting start time (2026-08-11T19:00:00-07:00) or whenever the meeting is called to order, as recorded in the meeting minutes or attendance log. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
